big_picture: Test whether a strong external foundation time-series model adds standalone or complementary return information without widening the search adaptively.

historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: A new, distinct TimesFM role with its own bounded hypothesis and untouched confirmation path.
historical_facts.observed: Standalone point forecasts did not beat zero-return; some representations were complementary to HistGB, but all 12 bounded blends failed the stronger zero-return joint gate.
historical_facts.rules_out: Promotion of the tested TimesFM return/blend programme and treating the consumed 204 rows as fresh confirmation.

programme_interpretation: Do not continue generic TimesFM return/blend search; preserve the complementarity observation without promoting it.
remaining_untested_roles: distinct non-return or representation roles only if programme-value justified
revisit_trigger: Require a new mechanism, target or role that could materially change a programme decision plus fresh confirmation capacity.
tested_role_target_horizon: TimesFM 2.5 zero-shot next-session return representations and exactly 12 preregistered 50/50 blends with V1 HistGB.
useful_secondary_observations: Complementarity against another model is insufficient if the combined system still fails the economic/statistical baseline.
A bounded successor avoided turning an observation into open-ended blend search.
why_zoomed_in: A bounded zero-shot challenger could test model-family complementarity while preserving the same 204-row comparison contract.
